{{Quote|I never did have the heart to tell Mama that Papa ran away&hellip;or that he died.|Ziro Desilijic Tiure, about his father's passing|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>}}
'''Papa''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the father of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] and the husband of [[Mama/Legends|Mama]] the Hutt.

==Biography==
The Hutt left his wife, ostensibly without her knowing it, and she never knew that he had [[Death/Legends|died]]. When he died, he was buried on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. His [[Tomb of Ziro the Hutt's father/Legends|grave]] concealed a [[Holodiary/Legends|holodiary]] containing [[Hutt Council records/Legends|incriminating information]] about the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council's]] illegal activities. When Ziro and [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] traveled to Teth to retrieve the holodiary, Snootles betrayed and killed Ziro, taking the holodiary with her and turning it over to Ziro's nephew, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].
